adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is normalized to lowercase (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`), but the filter checks `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` where `guest` is not lowercased. This makes the blacklist check case-sensitive on the input side, allowing emails like `Spam@x.com` to bypass a blacklist entry `spam@x.com`.
